d01-ask-phone.observed_description: The same room and the same Luis (short dark hair, navy T-shirt) and Ana (long wavy black hair, olive-green shirt) as the address-question photo; Luis now holds a black smartphone with its screen toward himself, a finger ready to tap, and asks Ana a question with raised eyebrows and an open mouth while she listens.
